description: Get official docs, API references, and code snippets for libraries/packages (e.g. 'react', 'fastapi', 'next.js'). Queries Context7 with fallback to npm/PyPI registry and GitHub README. Direct, no proxy needed.

library.description: Library or package name (e.g. 'next.js', 'react', 'fastapi') or exact Context7 library ID (e.g. '/vercel/next.js', version-pinnable like '/vercel/next.js@v15.1.8')

limit.description: Maximum number of code snippets to return (default 5)

query.description: The question, feature, or task to get relevant documentation for (optional; defaults to an overview when omitted, e.g. 'how to set up middleware with auth')

strict.description: If true, rejects low-confidence library name matches with an error instead of returning loosely matched candidate docs (default false)

name: queryDocs
